    Has Sinner won any awards yet?

    AI Overview
    Yes, the film Sinners (2025) has won numerous awards and accolades, including significant wins at the Golden Globes, BAFTAs, NAACP Image Awards, and Grammys, with stars Michael B. Jordan and Wunmi Mosaku receiving major acting honors, and Ryan Coogler winning for screenplay and directing. The film also set an Oscar nomination record with 16 nods for the 2026 Academy Awards.
     
    This video provides a summary of the film's record-breaking Oscar nominations:
    1m
    John Campea
    YouTube · Jan 22, 2026
    Key Awards & Wins:
    • Academy Awards (2026): 16 nominations (record-breaking), including Best Picture, Director (Ryan Coogler), Actor (Michael B. Jordan), Supporting Actress (Wunmi Mosaku). 
    • Golden Globes (2026): Wins for Best Actor (Michael B. Jordan) and Cinematic/Box Office Achievement. 
    • BAFTAs (2026): Wins for Best Supporting Actress (Wunmi Mosaku), Original Screenplay (Ryan Coogler), and Original Score (Ludwig Göransson). 
    • NAACP Image Awards (2026): Led with 13 wins, including Entertainer of the Year (Michael B. Jordan), Best Actor, Best Supporting Actress, Best Film, Best Director, and Best Original Score. 
    • Grammys (2026): Wins for Best Score Soundtrack for Visual Media and Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media. 
    • Critics' Choice Awards (2025): Four wins. 
    • Actor Awards (2026): Best Cinematic/Box Office Achievement, Best Actor (Michael B. Jordan). 
    Other Recognition: 
    • Named among the top ten films of 2025 by the National Board of Review and the American Film Institute.

      Which actress left her Oscar in the restroom?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Meryl Streep famously left her first Oscar in the bathroom during the 1980 Academy Awards ceremony after winning for Kramer vs. Kramer, leaving the statuette on a counter before retrieving it, while Kate Winslet and Emma Thompson are known for keeping their Oscars in their bathrooms as decorative items.
       
      Meryl Streep's Incident 
      • When: 1980, after winning Best Supporting Actress for Kramer vs. Kramer.
      • What Happened: In the excitement of the night, she placed the Oscar on a bathroom counter and forgot it, but thankfully, retrieved it before leaving.
      Other Actresses & Their Bathrooms
      • Kate Winslet:
        Keeps her Oscar in the bathroom, encouraging guests to pick it up and practice acceptance speeches. 
      • Emma Thompson:
        Stores her Oscars in the bathroom, finding them too flashy for other spots and even placing mirrors nearby for guests to take selfies with them.
